_source: CORE Math Pacing Guide Grade 2 - Open Up Resources with Open Up (OUR Math), uploaded 8/30/26, transcribed by week. Same segment-list schema as Grade K/1's our_math_g{K,1}_weeks.json.
_note: Module = Unit (OUR Math's own numbering), Unit = Section (hyphenated when a week spans multiple sections within the same Unit, e.g. 'A-B'). Guide typo, same family as Grade 1's: the header table for weeks 23, 24, 26 and 27 undercounts the outgoing section's actual lesson range in its own header row (week 23 says 'Section C Lessons 13-14' but the week's own lesson list runs through Lesson 15; week 24 says 'Section D Lessons 18-21' but the body runs through Lesson 22; week 26 says 'Section A Lessons 4-5' but the body starts at Lesson 3; week 27 says 'Section B Lessons 9-11 & Section C Lessons 12-13' but the body runs Section B 8-11 and Section C 12 only) - resolved in favor of the week's own lesson-by-lesson content in all four cases, confirmed against Appendix A's Grade 2 OUR Math bullets in 2627_LP_Meeting_Plan.md, which independently reproduce the same header text alongside a title list that matches the body, not the header. Course finishes at week 35 (Unit 9 Assessment); week 36 in the guide is a generic 'Review' page (dice games, math mosaics) not tied to any Unit/Section/Lesson, matching no M|U|L content at all, so it carries no key here - same shape as Grade 1's course ending one week early. Confirmed against Appendix A: LP1-3 verified line-for-line (lesson lists, checkpoint placement, and header text including the shared typos all match); LP4-10 spot-checked and consistent, including the recurring pattern where a Unit's final Section Checkpoint and that Unit's own Assessment land in the same guide week as the unit's last lessons (weeks 9, 13, 20) rather than in the following week's Assessments-only segment (weeks 6, 17, 25, 29, 32).
